name: baseline
notes: Iterative localized baseline fit solely within the 20-min window.

name: stv
notes: Mean absolute adjacent sample differences (diff) within window.

name: ltv
notes: 1-minute epoch percentile ranges within window, excluding decelerations.

name: acc_count
notes: Count of accelerations (>=15 bpm for >=15s) starting within window.

name: early_dec_count
notes: Decelerations synchronous with contraction peaks in window.

name: late_dec_count
notes: Decelerations with nadir lagging contraction peak in window.

name: var_dec_count
notes: Variable decelerations with steep descent (<30s) in window.

name: prolonged_dec_count
notes: Decelerations lasting between 2 and 5 minutes in window.

name: dec_max_depth
notes: Maximum amplitude drop below baseline across window decelerations.

name: dec_area
notes: Integrated bpm*seconds area for all decelerations in window.

name: dec_burden
notes: Proportion of window duration occupied by active decelerations.

name: longest_dec
notes: Duration in seconds of the single longest deceleration in window.

name: baseline_slope
notes: Linear slope of baseline within the 20-min window (bpm/hour).

name: variability_slope
notes: Linear slope of 1-min epoch STV/LTV across the window.

name: uc_count
notes: Count of qualifying uterine contraction peaks within window.

name: tachysystole
notes: Binary flag for contraction frequency > 5 per 10 minutes in window.

name: mean_uc_amp
notes: Average peak amplitude of uterine contractions in window.

name: fhr_uc_lag
notes: Average time lag from contraction peak to nearest FHR nadir in window.

name: fhr_uc_coupling
notes: Normalized cross-correlation between FHR and UC in window.
